title: Elite: Ascend the Choir Vault Threshold: Name at the Gate
description: Elite: Ascend the Choir Vault Threshold: Name at the Gate is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Choir-Vault Discord Ascent through The Choir-Vault Gate (Wound Gate leaking memory-burning radiance). One selected deity from Michael, Sophia, Shekinah, Gabriel enters; this beat spotlights Sophia as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the entry step at Choir Vault Threshold, using vertical cathedral ascent and judgment machinery pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Radiant Hierarchies is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Choir-Vault Discord Ascent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Choir Vault Threshold and reveals: How seraph flame burns corruption and memory alike. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
